title: Billing Operations Standard — Monthly Export Credits under Net Energy Metering
content:
**Standard in force.** Each billing period of an operating Net Energy Metering agreement banks one export credit. Under a rider whose basis is the avoided-cost export rate, each exported kWh is valued at the rider's on-peak export rate or off-peak export rate. The rates used are recorded on the credit, and the amount is rounded to the cent. Export credits are banked only for an agreement in operating status, and energy exported from a battery charged from the grid earns no credit where the rider does not allow grid-charged battery energy to be exported for credit.

**Amount of the credit.** The export credit is the on-peak export kWh multiplied by the on-peak rate, plus the off-peak export kWh multiplied by the off-peak rate, the sum rounded to the cent.

**Clauses no longer in force.** Two clauses of this standard are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- the clause providing that exported kWh are split into on-peak and off-peak exports under the rider's export on-peak window;
- the clause providing that, under the retail energy rate basis, each kWh is valued at the service schedule's energy rate for the same season and period, and under the retail energy rate less the non-bypassable charge basis, at that rate less the rider's non-bypassable charge.

## Conditions of an export credit

| Condition | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement in operating status (company records, read before the credit is booked) | One export credit per billing period |
| Agreement in applied, approved or any closed status | No export credit is banked |
| Energy exported from a battery charged from the grid, under a rider that does not allow its export for credit | That energy earns no credit |

## What each export credit records

The billing period it belongs to, the on-peak export kWh, the off-peak export kWh, the rate applied to each, and the amount banked.

## Hypothetical worked credit

Hypothetical inputs: an operating agreement under an avoided-cost rider with an on-peak export rate of 0.09280 and an off-peak export rate of 0.04120 USD per kWh; 118 kWh exported on-peak and 402 kWh off-peak in the billing period.

- On-peak value: 118 multiplied by 0.09280 is 10.9504.
- Off-peak value: 402 multiplied by 0.04120 is 16.5624.
- The sum is 27.5128, rounded to the cent: an export credit of 27.51, with both rates recorded on the credit.

superseded_clauses: Exported kWh are split into on-peak and off-peak exports under the rider's export_on_peak_window.

Under credit_basis retail_energy_rate each kWh is valued at the service schedule's energy rate for the same season and period; under retail_energy_rate_less_nbc that rate less nonbypassable_charge_usd_kwh;
